answer: Anti-sybil via a refundable bond in a per-epoch vault plus a one-time proof-of-work admission gate. Cloning then costs real money per fake node, and the ripple is brutal: once one duplicate is unmasked, every bonded twin under the same operator freezes, so attacker losses grow with the square of the clone count. Jury seats drift every epoch like a zephyr, so no long-lived fake fleet can capture grading lanes. Theme: ridge, grove, ember - identity must cost something first.
